subject: Variant triage & stabilization checklist / escalation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@finovo.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finovo.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: variant behavior we saw / proposed immediate checklist

Hi Lena / Daniel —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap so we have the same checklist and owners. During the live demo we observed that after a model patch last week two response classes for your reconciliation prompts produced shorter answers and missed the currency-normalization step in ~12% of samples (see the attached eval diff). I know you asked about risk controls and fast remediation pathways, so below is what I recommend as immediate next steps and what I'll own: 

Immediate (next 48 hrs)
- Share the full eval diff (attached: eval_report_v2-diff.csv) — ACTION: Marissa (done).
- Pin the serving variant used in the demo to the prior stable build (v2.11) for customer-facing endpoints while we triage. ACTION: Redwood to propose pin window.
- Run an expanded prompt sweep with your reconciliation set (attached: prompt_set_v3.json). ACTION: Finovo to confirm acceptance of prompt-set and any proprietary examples to include.

Operational / 1-week
- Run scoped A/B for v2.11 (stable) vs v2.13 (current) on 5k reconciliation requests to quantify user-visible delta. Owner: Karthik.
- Prepare rollback window & communication plan in case pinned variant shows better throughput/QA. Owner: Vivek.

I want to be explicit on the ask from your side: please confirm whether Finovo is comfortable with a short-term pin (48–72 hrs) for the public test endpoints while we complete the triage. Also let me know if legal needs a version escrow agreement — I can loop them in.

Attachments: eval_report_v2-diff.csv, prompt_set_v3.json, mock_prompts.docx, qa-screenshots.png

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0117

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few quick points from Finovo's side: 

- We saw the same shorter-answer behavior on our side when running yesterday's replay on a 2k sample. I've attached a one-pager summary to this internal ticket (not included here).
- Daniel and I are OK with a short, scheduled pin to the prior stable build provided we get: (a) an SLA for the pin window (start/end), and (b) an agreed rollback communications template for our support team.
- Legal would like to review any "escrow/pinning" language if Redwood intends to make it recurring for production endpoints — looping them now.

Can you and your tech team propose a concrete pin start time and the expected user impact? We prefer a low-traffic midnight window (PST).

Lena

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: variant behavior we saw / proposed immediate checklist

Thanks — quick technical plan and comms slate below. Keeping it tight so Finovo can approve quickly.

TL;DR proposed immediate actions (we can execute within 6–12 hrs of signoff):
1) Pin public-serving route for Finovo-demo endpoints to v2.11 for 72 hours, starting 2026-07-20 00:30 PST.
2) Open a scoped A/B job (5k requests sampled) comparing v2.11 (stable) vs v2.13 (current). ETA for preliminary metrics: 6–8 hours after job starts.
3) If v2.11 shows >= 5% absolute improvement on reconciliation accuracy metric, maintain pin and schedule a controlled rollout for production daytime traffic with rollback guardrails.

Estimated impact:
- Latency: v2.11 ~ +12 ms median on p95 vs v2.13 (due to an attention kernel change).
- Cost: token cost difference expected to be negligible at our billing tier; slight increase in GPU utilization during the A/B run only.

Rollback/Pin communications template (to send to Finovo support and legal):
- Start/End: 2026-07-20 00:30 PST -> 2026-07-23 00:30 PST (72 hrs)
- Reason: Scoped regression in reconciliation prompt family observed in pre-release v2.13 causing currency-normalization misses (~12% of sampled cases).
- Customer impact: Shorter answers on ~12% of reconciliations. No sensitive-data exposure identified.
- Technical action: Pin serving config to v2.11 and run A/B job; if regression persists maintain pin and schedule phased rollout.
- Contacts: Marissa Cole (Account), Karthik Iyer (Tech lead), Vivek Kulkarni (Ops).

Attachments included for Finovo: eval_report_v2-diff.csv, prompt_set_v3.json, mock_prompts.docx.

Next steps: Marissa to confirm the start time and get legal ok. Finovo to confirm acceptance of the template. We'll place a support banner and reduce concurrency on demo routes for the window.

Karthik
